main_text.l: תְּבִיאוּ venire facietis , תְּבִיאֶינָה facient , fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. & 3. pl. f. Rad. בוא .
תְּבִיאֶנָה venire facient , Lev. 7. 30. pro תְּבִיאֶנָה , fut. Hiph. 3. pl. f. Rad. בוא .
תָּבִיט , vel תָּבֵט intueberis, vel tur, fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָבַט .
תָּבִין intelliget , vel ges , תָּבִינוּ intelligetis , fut. Hiph. 3. s. f. f. vel 2. s. m. & 2. pl. m. Rad. בין .
תַּבִּיץ erudiabit [?], fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָבַץ [?] .
וְתִבְכֶּה & flevit , תִּבְכֶּינָה flebunt, fut. Kal, s. apoc. (pro תִּבְכֶּה ) & pl. R. בָּכָה .
תֶּבֶל confusio , No. s. m. Rad. בָּלַל confudit.
תִּבֹּל decides , fut. Kal, sing. Rad. נָבַל .
תִּבְלָה veterascit, 3. fut. f. Kal, sing. Rad. בָּלָה .
תִּבְלוּל suffusio, vitium oculi , No. f. m. Rad. בָּלַל confudit.
תִּבְלִיתָם consumptio eorum , No. f. f. aff. Rad. בָּלָה veterascere.
כְּ־תָבֶן sicut palea , No. sing. m. præf. Rad.
וַיִּבֶן & ædificavit , (apoc. pro תִּבְנֶה ,) fut. Kal, sing. Rad. בָּנָה .
תִּבְנֶה ædificabitur , תִּבָּנֶינָה ædificabuntur , fut. Niph. f. 3. sing. & plur. Rad. בָּנָה .
תִּבְנִיתָם structura ipsorum , No. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. בָּנָה ædificavit.
תִּבְעָה bullat, fut. Kal, sing. Rad. בָּעָה .
תִּבְעָיוּן quæretis, Jef. 21. 12. (pro תִּבְעוּן ,) fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. בָּעָה .

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants were read from a small, blotted scan and are approximate; they are not certain letter by letter. Lines marked [?] are doubtful: "erudiabit" and its root; the page number "420" has a blot. The Hebrew of several roots (e.g. בָּלַל, נָבַץ, בָּעָה) may need checking against the scan at higher resolution. The second column's final line runs on to the next page; "Hiph." is the last printed word here. Latin abbreviations are kept as printed.
